mapper.select: /*selectMasterMpDsSeedKindPopList*/ SELECT A.USER_ID, --0 A.PASSWORD, --1 A.USER_NAME_LOC, --2 A.USER_NAME_ENG, --3 A.LANG, --4 NVL(A.MAIL_RECV_FLAG,'N'), --5 A.EMAIL, --6 A.USER_TYPE, --7 A.ZIP_CODE, --8 (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M001' AND CODE = A.COUNTRY) COUNTRY, --9 (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M004' AND CODE = A.CITY) CITY, --10 A.COUNTRY, --11 A.CITY, --12 A.MOBILE_PHONE, --13 A.ADDRESS_LOC, --14 A.ADDRESS_ENG, --15 A.PHONE_NUMBER, --16 A.FAX_NUMBER, --17 B.COM_NAME_LOC, --18 (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE='C001' AND CODE = A.DEPARTMENT AND COMPANY_CODE = A.COM_CODE) DEPARTMENT, --19 (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE='C003' AND CODE = A.POSITION AND COMPANY_CODE = A.COM_CODE) POSITION, --20 A.PURCHASE_DEPT, --21 A.ROLE, --22 NVL(A.SMS_RECV_FLAG,'N'), --23 A.DEPARTMENT, --24 A.POSITION, --25 A.COM_CODE, --26 A.CHANGE_USER_TYPE, --27 (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE='C001' AND CODE = A.PURCHASE_DEPT AND COMPANY_CODE = A.COM_CODE) PURCHASE_DEPT, --28 A.DELY_TO_LOCATION, --29 (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE='C012' AND COMPANY_CODE = A.COM_CODE AND CODE = A.DELY_TO_LOCATION) DELY_TEXT, --30 DECODE(SUBSTR(A.ROLE,2,1),'+','주문 : ','')|| DECODE(SUBSTR(A.ROLE,0,1),'G','입고','P','발주','C','발주 : 입고','U','조회') item_name, -- 31 A.ROLE, --32 NVL(A.PERSON_AUTHOR,'PR'), --33 A.USER_GROUP, --34 B.BUSINESS_COND --35 FROM ICOMLUSR A, ICOMCMPY B WHERE UPPER(A.USER_ID) = UPPER(#{st_user_id}) AND A.COM_CODE = B.COM_CODE AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'D'
